title: Alphabet Board Path
summary: Starting at (0, 0) on an alphabet board with the layout ["abcde", "fghij", "klmno", "pqrst", "uvwxy", "z"], we can move up ('U'), down ('D'), left ('L'), or right ('R') to adjacent letters.
statement: Starting at (0, 0) on an alphabet board with the layout ["abcde", "fghij", "klmno", "pqrst", "uvwxy", "z"], we can move up ('U'), down ('D'), left ('L'), or right ('R') to adjacent letters. The move '!' adds the current letter to the answer. Return a sequence of moves to spell out the target word with the fewest moves, allowing any valid path.
constraints: The board rows are abcde through uvwxy with z alone below u.
For deterministic grading move Up, then Left, then Down, then Right before selecting with !.
hints: Map each letter index to row,column with divmod by five.
Move up and left before down and right so leaving or entering z never crosses missing cells.
Append one ! after reaching each target character.
The coordinate differences give a shortest route and the move order makes it valid and deterministic.
editorial: The coordinate differences give a shortest route and the move order makes it valid and deterministic.

tests.explanation: Moves select l,e,e,t while staying on valid cells.
